{{Quote|It so happens I might know where you might find that ship. Name's the ''First Light'', and you can find it on landing platform IIB8. Might want to hurry, though&hellip;|Fenix, to the freelance agents searching for the ''First Light''|<ref name="Outward Bound" />}}
'''Landing platform IIB8''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|landing platform]] in use on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a tumultuous conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Outward Bound" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''[[Looking In: Outward Bound]]'' is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[First Light (freighter)|First Light]]'' was captured by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Brotherhood]] en-route to Druckenwell while hauling a cargo of explosives and was taken by the pirates to landing platform IIB8. A group of Separatist sympathizers allied with the pirates schemed to crash the explosive-laden freighter into the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic military]] [[Space station/Legends|installation]] ''[[New Dawn (space station)|New Dawn]]'' and readied the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] for the attack. However, group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] investigating the plot obtained the location of the landing platform from the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] [[Fenix]] and arrived at the platform just as the ''First Light'' was taking off. The agents subsequently stowed away aboard the ship and thwarted the attack.<ref name="Outward Bound" />

==Behind the scenes==
Landing platform IIB8 appeared ''[[Looking In: Outward Bound]]'' by [[Morrie Mullins]] and [[Lee Pickler]], a [[2002]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure that formed part of the [[Looking In trilogy]] of [[RPGA]]'s ''[[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]]'' campaign.<ref name="Outward Bound" />
